summary: Codec sub-object teardown. Validates the object (this) and the sub-object pointer at this+0x1C, then requires the codec mode tag at *(this+0x1C)+0x4 to be one of 42, 113, or 666. Conditionally invokes the cleanup function pointer stored at this+0x24 (with this+0x28 as its argument) for each non-zero flag at sub-object offsets +0x8, +0x2E, +0x36, +0x3A, then makes one unconditional final cleanup call passing the sub-object itself. Zeroes this+0x1C and returns 0xFD (253) when the mode tag is 113, otherwise 0.

local_names.this: codec container holding the sub-object pointer and the cleanup function pointer
local_names.v3: codec mode tag read from v2+4

operations.description: Return -2 when the sub-object pointer at this+0x1C is NULL
Return -2 when the codec mode tag at *(this+0x1C)+0x4 is not 42, 113, or 666
When the parameter at *(this+0x1C)+0x8 is non-zero, call the fastcall cleanup function pointer at this+0x24 with (this+0x28, *(this+0x1C)+0x8)
When the flag at *(this+0x1C)+0x2E is non-zero, call the thiscall cleanup function pointer at this+0x24 with this+0x28
When the flag at *(this+0x1C)+0x36 is non-zero, call the thiscall cleanup function pointer at this+0x24 with this+0x28
When the flag at *(this+0x1C)+0x3A is non-zero, call the thiscall cleanup function pointer at this+0x24 with this+0x28
Unconditional final cleanup: call the function pointer at this+0x24 with (this+0x28, this+0x1C) to release the sub-object itself
Zero the sub-object pointer at this+0x1C after teardown (init literal 0)
Return 0xFD (253) when the mode tag is 113, otherwise 0; called from FileHandleDestructorWithModeCheck (0x00534EE0) and sub_535C10 (0x00535C10)
